shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile carved in low relief
relief carving on a broad flat vertical face of a T-shaped/rectangular pillar
animal(s) placed on the upper part of the shaft, walking/standing posture
outline-and-flat-field relief with limited interior detail
justification: Both show low-relief profile quadrupeds with legs and tail rendered in simple raised outline on the flat broad face of a T-headed pillar, the animal set on the upper shaft in the same way. The decisive difference is density and variety: A carries a crowded multi-register programme (a row of crouching quadrupeds under the head, a woven/net band, large birds in profile, a small anthropomorphic figure, snake and bird-head motifs), whereas B carries essentially a single isolated animal on an otherwise blank field.
